ops.body: Verified at 16b9265: every F7/D8(ii) requirement is enforced and tested. ServeSpawned exists as the second child-side entry (childside.go:61; spawned_test.go:89 round trip). It adopts the conveyed limits and refuses a disagreeing contract (childside.go:72 -> business.go:50 Contract.adopt; TestServeSpawnedRefusesLimitsTheSpawnDidNotConvey, TestContractAdoptsOrRefusesTheConveyedLimits). The nonce is conveyed and enforced constant-time (internal/wire/spawned.go:119-121; TestSpawnedSessionRejectsWrongNonce). Double-claim is a named refusal in either order (childside.go:28 errHandoffClaimed, :114-122; TestServeSpawnedIsSingleTakeAfterClaimHandoff, TestClaimHandoffIsSingleTake). Per-end MaxFrame is enforced inside the session (internal/wire/spawned.go:80-86; TestSpawnedSessionEnforcesDeclaredMaxFrame). Exactly one session is served and the conveyance is unset after read (childside.go:77-84, :124-135; TestChildBusinessIsTerminalOnItsSingleSession, childside_test.go:185). Residual, intentional per the godoc: bare ClaimHandoff() returns only the conn — the non-Go-child lane where the caller owns the protocol; not an F7 gap.
